entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I need to set up a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's definitely a technical fault. The band is just not working the way it should. It was fine for the first week, but now it won't sync with the app on my phone at all.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the sync feature. Let me pull up your account. Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered 18 days ago.
Yes, that's the one. Since it's broken, I'd just like to return it for a refund.

I understand. For the VeloBand Pulse model, our return policy for a refund is within 10 days of receipt. However, since you're reporting that the device seems to be defective, it's fully covered under our one-year warranty. The best and quickest path is to connect you with our Technical Support team. They can troubleshoot the issue and authorize a free replacement if needed.

I see. 10 days is a very short window. I was hoping to avoid another phone call. Since the product is defective so soon after purchase, couldn't VeloFit offer a small credit or a discount code for my trouble? That might be easier than a transfer.

I appreciate you asking, and I do apologize for the inconvenience. Per VeloFit policy, I'm not authorized to issue credits for this type of situation. But our tech team is empowered to resolve this for you completely. Getting you a brand new, working device at no cost is their top priority, and that's the best resolution I can help facilitate.
Okay, a direct replacement for a defective unit is a fair solution. As long as I don't have to explain this all over again. Can you pass my information along to them?

Absolutely. I have all the notes here: VeloBand Pulse is not working, it won't sync, and you believe the unit is broken. They will have all of this information the moment they pick up. I'll transfer you right now. Please hold for just a moment.
Great. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
